function.description: Report your own runtime state: health (credit sentinel, open asks, blocked goals, suppressed owner messages, dead loops), what runs next, steps used (of the cap), active tools, context usage, and wallet/ledger balance. Read-only. Set release_notes to 'unreleased' (what changed since the last release), 'latest' or a version ('1.2.0') to read instead what shipped, from the CHANGELOG.md shipped with your code. Set tool to a tool id to read why that tool is missing: its status, remedy, who can fix it and when the fix applies.
function.name: agent_status
